description: Image Description: The image depicts a public restroom with a highly artistic and colorful design. The walls are covered in white square tiles, forming a clean and structured backdrop. Above the sinks, there is a decorative mosaic border running horizontally across the wall, composed of vibrant blue, yellow, red, and black tiles arranged in an abstract, wavy pattern.
